title: Beyond the Square-Root Exponent for Depth-Three Boolean Circuits
summary: We construct a language in deterministic polynomial time whose n -bit membership function requires $`2^{\omega(\sqrt n)}`$ gates in an unbounded-fan-in OR–AND–OR circuit. The bound holds at every sufficiently large input length and counts all gates, including the bottom layer.
family_title: Beyond the square-root exponent for depth-three circuits

review.reason: Gives a circuit lower bound for depth-three Boolean circuits beyond the square-root exponent.
